Geographies Served Programs Women Care Programmes Its women care programmes feature the provision of primary, secondary and higher secondary education, college education, health education for adolescent girls, safe motherhood, women empowerment programmes and widow welfare programmes. A specific programme, Sowing for Energy, Empowerment and Development(SEED) programme seeks to provide a livelihood to women through the cultivation of organic kitchen gardens. Tribal Care Programmes Through its tribal care programmes, the institution tries to work for the welfare of tribal and backward communities by enabling services of healthcare, education, skill development initiatives and providing resource support Healthcare Programmes District Valsad The Dangs State Gujarat District Valsad The Dangs States Gujarat Its healthcare programmes range from holding health awareness camps, IPD and OPD services, safe motherhood services, neonatal intensive care units, early intervention centres, child malnutrition treatment centres, viklang centre and mobile medical care units. It also manages the Shrimad Rajchandra Hospital a 250-bed multi-speciality charitable hospital catering to the healthcare needs of the poor and needy. Education Programmes District Valsad State Gujarat District Valsad States Gujarat Its education programmes include providing primary, secondary and higher secondary education through the Shrimad Rajchandra Gurukul and Vidyavihar, college education through Shrimad Rajchandra Vidyapeeth, learning education and development, educational outreach, educational loans and educational aids to the underprivileged sections of society. Child Care Programmes District Valsad State Gujarat District Valsad States Gujarat Its childcare programmes include neonatal intensive care units, early intervention centres, child malnutrition treatment centres, mid-day meals, holistic education and supporting Angalwadi’s and orphanages. It also provides a platform for the youth to showcase their talents in performing arts through conducting the Shrimad Rajchandra Kala Utsav and supporting children with learning difficulties with remedial education and learning. Vision and Mission SRLC aims to empower rural youth to realize their true potential through holistic quality education and to be a role model of educational excellence for the holistic development of its students.
